proposals.issue_title: Runaway API Spending & Daily Budget Exhaustion
proposals.current_pain_description: With automatic CRON triggers on GitHub Actions and paid APIs like Runware (PAYG) or Together AI (after free credits), a bug/infinite loop in a script could consume Hugo's entire 20€ monthly budget in minutes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a central Python state file ('state_billing.json') saved back to the repo via git. Every pipeline calling a paid API must check this file, estimate the call cost, increment the daily spend, and instantly abort (circuit-breaker) if the daily limit (e.g., 0.50€) is exceeded.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents financial loss and keeps the solo-biz strictly within the 20€/month hard ceiling.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Failures and Corrupted Image Generation in GHA
proposals.current_pain_description: When image APIs (Pollinations, Together, Runware) return 500, 429, or cloud-flare challenge pages, scripts often save the HTML error or a 0-byte file as an image. This silently pollutes the output artifacts and breaks downstream PDF/KDP compilation.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a mandatory post-generation validation step using the Python 'Pillow' library. Attempt to open the image and verify size > 10KB. If invalid, trigger an automated retry with a fallback provider (e.g., Together AI -> Runware -> Pollinations as absolute fallback).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates empty/corrupt outputs, saving manual check time on Hugo's phone.

proposals.issue_title: No-PC Blindness: Monitoring GitHub Actions on Mobile is Painful
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has an Android phone. Navigating the desktop-oriented GitHub Actions UI via mobile browser to see if a pipeline succeeded or why it failed is slow, frustrating, and wastes his 10h/week.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight Telegram Bot or Discord Webhook notifier. At the end of every GHA workflow run, send a formatted message to Hugo's private chat with: run status, number of generated assets, direct download links to artifacts, and preview images.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 1-2 hours per week of manual log-checking; enables 1-tap mobile monitoring.

proposals.issue_title: Duplicate API Integration Code across 15+ Pipelines
proposals.current_pain_description: Each pipeline currently handles its own API calls, error handling, rate limiting, and output formatting. If Together AI updates its API format, Hugo has to manually update dozens of python scripts on Termux.
proposals.proposed_fix: Refactor all image and LLM calls into a single, shared Python module ('src/utils/api_client.py'). Pipelines should import 'generate_image(prompt, engine)' and 'generate_text(prompt)'. This module handles API-key rotation, fallback logic, and budget limits in one place.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Massive maintenance relief. Single point of failure fixed. Easy to switch provider endpoints.

proposals.issue_title: Garbled Text Rendered by FLUX/SDXL on Book Covers
proposals.current_pain_description: AI models (even FLUX-schnell) frequently generate misspelt, warped, or gibberish text when requested to put titles on book covers or quotes on posters, looking highly unprofessional and unsellable.
proposals.proposed_fix: Enforce a strict separation of concerns: prompt the AI to generate *only* background art (negative prompt: 'text, words, letters, watermark'). Use Python's 'Pillow' (PIL) library to programmatically overlay crisp, perfectly aligned vector fonts (using free Google Fonts loaded in the repo) for titles and subtitles.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 100% perfect text spelling on every cover, ensuring immediate professional retail quality.

proposals.current_pain_description: Assets generated for a coloring book (black and white line art) are only used for Amazon KDP. This misses easy revenue from other platforms already on Hugo's list.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add an automated packaging sub-step. When 'produce_coloring_book' runs, it should also export: 1) Individual high-res PNGs packaged as a ZIP for Etsy digital downloads. 2) A Redbubble pack of individual sticker designs. This multiplies output catalog size with zero extra AI costs.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Triples the surface area of distribution (KDP + Etsy + Redbubble) for the exact same generation budget.
